description: Accept or dismiss one todo item by id (from list_todo). Accepting does what the card's button does: a post idea starts generating, a connection card returns the link to send. If the user changed a draft before saying yes, pass their version as finalText. Always confirm with the user before accepting anything that sends or publishes.

action.description: accept = yes, do it; dismiss = no thanks

finalText.description: The user's edited version of the draft, when they changed it

itemId.description: The todo item id from list_todo
